name: pam_loginuid
description: Set login UID attribute for process accounting
detailed_description: Session module that sets the login UID (LOGINUID) attribute in the kernel for process accounting and audit logging. Essential for proper audit trail tracking and system accounting. Typically used with systemd and auditd.

parameters.require_action: Fail if LOGINUID cannot be set

notes:
Essential for Linux audit framework; sets login UID for process accounting and audit trail.
